EVERY position on that list MUST have AT LEAST ONE row in the table below. More than one row for a position is CORRECT.

# TABLE TO CHECK
pass: Every position on the list has AT LEAST ONE row, and every Kind in the table is a position on that list. More than one row for a position is CORRECT, never a fault.
fail: A position on the list with NO row, or a Kind in the table that is not on the list (including `entree`). Name every one.
